title: Project kind detection
responsibility: Read project kind and declared game dimension for scaffold eligibility and configuration.

inputs.name: detectProjectKind.root
inputs.description: Project directory to inspect for package.json, svelte.config.js and src/index.ts.

inputs.name: detectGameDimension.root
inputs.description: Project root whose package.json supplies the game dimension.

outputs.name: detectProjectKind
outputs.description: App or lib from explicit package harness.kind first; otherwise app for Svelte configuration/dependency/check script, lib for a readable package and src/index.ts, or unknown. Read/parse/access failures are treated as missing evidence.

outputs.name: detectGameDimension
outputs.description: Supported declared game dimension, or undefined when absent or invalid.
